characters.summary: Nakia is a skilled Wakandan War Dog and spy who specializes in covert operations, martial arts, and close-quarters combat using her signature ring blades.
limitations: Lacks superhuman physical durability or regenerative healing

sources.supports: Nakia's background as a War Dog, her ring blades, combat skills, and gear.

feats.claim: Fought against Killmonger's faction during the coup in Wakanda.
Rescued enslaved humans from human traffickers in Nigeria.

notableResults.note: Overpowered during the takeover of Wakanda.

campaignTags.claim: Operates undercover as a Wakandan War Dog spy.
Utilizes espionage and stealth training during covert operations.
Uses specialized Wakandan ring blades and tech.

unknowns: Exact extent of her post-Blip covert missions before returning in Wakanda Forever.

characters.summary: Namor is the mutant king of Talokan, possessing superhuman strength, durability, and the unique ability to fly using tiny wings on his ankles.

techniques: Water manipulation via sheer physical force

limitations: Must stay hydrated to maintain peak fighting efficiency

sources.supports: Namor's abilities, Talokan background, ankle wings, and superhuman traits.

feats.claim: Fought Shuri to a standstill in a desert environment before trapping her.
Lifted and hurled heavy masonry and military equipment.

notableResults.note: Defeated Shuri in single combat after luring her to a dry area, though she ultimately trapped him.

campaignTags.claim: Flies using small wings attached to his ankles.
King of Talokan, an underwater civilization.
Can breathe underwater naturally.
Extremely fast swimmer in oceanic environments.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his lifting strength compared to other heavy-hitters.

characters.summary: Phoenix Five Namor represents an alternate cosmic-powered version drawing upon a fraction of the Phoenix Force.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to mental manipulation or disruption of the cosmic entity link
characters.formDifferences: Grants immense cosmic power, reality manipulation, cosmic fire, and planetary-scale telekinesis/energy projection derived from the Phoenix Force.

sources.supports: Base traits of Namor used for cross-reference in hypothetical variants.

unknowns: MCU continuity does not formally feature a Phoenix Five Namor; this is treated as a hypothetical comic-derived variant scaling.

characters.summary: Nebula is a cybernetic warrior and assassin trained by Thanos, wielding advanced energy weapons, high agility, and extensive self-repair capabilities.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to electronic disruption or having her cybernetic components overridden
limitations: Dependent on mechanical maintenance and power sources for some cybernetics

sources.supports: Nebula's cybernetic enhancements, weapons, and combat history.

feats.claim: Fought Gamora on multiple occasions using specialized weapons.
Helped defeat Thanos using her tactical knowledge of his ship and army.

notableResults.note: Subdued by Gamora after a fierce duel on Ego's planet.

campaignTags.claim: Her body is heavily augmented with cybernetic parts.
Possesses extensive computer systems and cybernetic tracking.
Utilizes energy batons, stun weapons, and retractable blades.

unknowns: Full limit of her resistance to high-yield thermal energy attacks.

characters.summary: Ned Leeds is Peter Parker's close friend and an accidental spellcaster who learns to open dimensional portals using a Sling Ring.
weaknesses: Standard human physical attributes with zero formal martial combat training
limitations: Lacks combat durability and offensive spells beyond opening portals

sources.supports: Ned Leeds' background, friendship with Spider-Man, and Sling Ring magic usage.

feats.claim: Successfully opened mystic portals to summon alternative versions of Peter Parker.

conditional.dependsOn: Possession and use of a Sling Ring

campaignTags.claim: Learns and uses mystic arts via a Sling Ring.
Opens dimensional portals using mystic arts.
Can transport people across locations using portals.
Casts spells to summon alternate Spider-Men through portals.

unknowns: Whether he will pursue further formal mystic arts training under Sorcerer Supreme guidance.

characters.summary: Nick Fury is a master strategist, spy, and former Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. who relies on firearms, tactical planning, and vast governmental resources.
limitations: Vulnerable to conventional physical injury and assassination

sources.supports: Nick Fury's role as Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., tactical skills, and weapons.

feats.claim: Survived an intense multi-car assassination ambush in Washington D.C.
Initiated the Avengers Initiative to handle global threats.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and critically injured in his vehicle.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots S.H.I.E.L.D. quinjets and aircraft.
Uses encrypted communication devices and advanced surveillance tech.
Master spy skilled in covert infiltration and false identities.

unknowns: Full extent of his off-world S.A.B.E.R. defense grid capabilities.

characters.summary: Obadiah Stane is a ruthless industrialist and combatant who fights primarily using massive, heavy-duty powered armor known as the Iron Monger.
weaknesses: Exposed cockpit seal and reliance on an external arc reactor power source configuration
limitations: Without the Iron Monger suit, he possesses standard human physical limits

sources.supports: Obadiah Stane, Stark Industries role, and Iron Monger suit specs.

feats.claim: Torn police cars and wrecked buildings during his rampage in Los Angeles.
Fought Tony Stark in the Mark III armor.

notableResults.note: Defeated after Stark overloaded the large arc reactor beneath him.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots the giant heavy-duty Iron Monger armor suit.
Stands significantly taller than humans when encased in the Iron Monger suit.
Uses advanced Stark-derived industrial weaponry.
Pilots the Iron Monger mecha suit directly from an internal cockpit.

unknowns: Whether he created any other automated suits besides the initial Iron Monger prototype.

characters.summary: Odin is the Allfather of Asgard, wielding immense cosmic-level magic, divine strength, and the power of the Odinforce.
weaknesses: Subject to the Odinsleep, a period of deep vulnerability required to recharge his immense power
limitations: Requires periodic bouts of deep sleep (Odinsleep) to sustain his vitality

sources.supports: Odin's status as Allfather, magic, Gungnir, and the Odinforce.

feats.claim: Stripped Thor of his divine powers and banished him to Earth along with Mjolnir.
Conquered the Nine Realms alongside Hela before sealing her away.

campaignTags.claim: Wields potent Asgardian magic and enchanting abilities.
Cast powerful exile and stripping spells on Thor.

unknowns: Full extent of his power output at his absolute historical prime.

characters.summary: Odin utilizing or animating the uru-metal Destroyer armor enhances his physical invulnerability and destructive energy projection.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to commands or controls from beings of higher or equal mystical authority
characters.formDifferences: Encased in the mystical Uru Destroyer automaton, granting total immunity to conventional harm and replacing his organic body with an enchanted automaton capable of firing continuous disintegration beams.

sources.supports: Properties of the Destroyer armor in MCU.

unknowns: Whether Odin directly wore the armor or enchanted it remotely.

characters.summary: Young Odin during the Prehistoric era was a ferocious conqueror who fought alongside the earliest defenders of Earth using raw divine might and ancient weapons.
weaknesses: Prone to aggressive overconfidence compared to his wise later years
characters.formDifferences: Represents a younger, more physically aggressive version of Odin prior to his unification of the Nine Realms and subsequent wisdom.

sources.supports: Historical context of Odin's earlier conquests.

unknowns: Exact encounters during the Prehistoric era outside of brief historical references.
